messages:
leah: Opening a PR to harmonize function/tool-calling and structured-output docs across SDKs, plus a link sweep. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/5175 — will tag small migration checklist in the description, please review snippets.

tom: On it. I'll audit Go and Java examples first. Note: older examples use `invoke`/`InvokeTool` in Go; we should switch to `client.CallTool(ctx, name, input)` in all samples.

arjun: Suggest adding a compact JSON Schema tolerant example and a tiny helper for envelope-stripping. Example schema to show tolerant parsing: `{ "type":"object", "properties": { "action": { "oneOf": [ {"type":"string","enum":["search","open","create"]}, {"type":"null"} ] } } }`

maya: Also recommend explicit enum guardrails for action discriminators — add a 1-line why in the docs. I'll test the JS streaming snippet locally (buffer before JSON.parse).

leah: I'll add a short migration checklist to the PR: 1) update SDK call names, 2) replace dead playground links, 3) add small unit/e2e examples, 4) port snippets to Private docs.

docs-bot: link-checker ran on branch -> 4 broken example links found, comments posted on PR.

tom: Found two stale Go snippets that still use `InvokeTool`; I'll replace and add a brief example test: `resp, err := client.CallTool(ctx, "search", input)` + simple envelope strip.

arjun: Envelope-strip helper (pseudo): ```python
def strip_envelope(resp_text):
  # naive: find first `{` and last `}` and parse
  body = resp_text[resp_text.find('{'):resp_text.rfind('}')+1]
  return json.loads(body)
``` Mention this is illustrative only.

maya: JS streaming buffer draft: ```js
let buf = '';
for await (const ch of client.streamTool(...)) buf += ch;
const obj = JSON.parse(buf);
``` Add comment about backpressure and large payloads.

leah: Good notes. I'll update the PR with the schema snippet, envelope helper remark, and the migration checklist. Targeting merge Friday EOD — please push any fixes before then.

tom: Will push Go fixes today and open a small follow-up issue to translate Go/Java snippets into Private docs (VPC/on-prem).

arjun: I'll add the tolerant schema example and a unit test that asserts schema validation allows null action.

maya: After push I'll run lint/format and a smoke run of the examples. If anything breaks I'll file a quick patch.

leah: Awesome. Thanks all :thumbsup:
